visualCharacteristics.purpose: lowest round-trip fare per month for the next 12 months, frozen at import, each month linking to the deep link of its cheapest date
traits: white 86px cards with 1px #dcdcdc border, 8px radius and a light shadow in a horizontal slider, years above the first card of each year
card height follows the price: the cheapest month is 60px lower than the dearest
bold 'from' and price at the top, month and date at the bottom, yellow 'Best price' badge on the cheapest month(s)
dark translucent arrow bars with white chevrons at the slider's edges, hidden at the ends
below 768px a list: grey date box, price, yellow bar at the right whose row width follows the price

contentPattern.structure: No header row. Month rows with 4 cells: Year (on the first month of a year, else empty) | Month (Oct.) | Date (28 Oct.) | Price (link 'from 220 €' to the deep link, optionally followed by a bold 'Best price' badge; no link = grey empty card). Optional 2-cell option rows: Heading, Subhead, Best price label, Previous label, Next label. Without a bold badge the cheapest month(s) get it; bar heights are computed from the prices.

usage.description: 'Lowest available fares' section of the AirCore route pages (section.best-price-per-month).

reuseGuidance: Use for a frozen fare-per-month chart with links. For live fares use price-bar or fare-teaser; for a list of linked deals table-deals. Exports readMonths, barScale and priceValue for tests.
